title: I made a music agent that can maintain thematic consistency for games
author: trekkerxxx
selftext:
I initially built the tool for my friends as he's solo developing the survival game. We tried a bunch of generic stock music and tried to piece them together, but only to find the music theme is not very consistent and they failed to translate to other sections. Composers are way above our budget so it's not an option for us.

I tried to put together one music generator for him, and he's loving it so far.. So I'm wondering if this could help with your game music needs too. I'm now looking for 50 beta testers and if anyone is interested, you can join the beta [discord](https://discord.gg/zxCyCmUWC3) with unique invite codes to try it out for free.

Some of the "interesting" features:

1. Tunee remembers your preferred music style and how you like to work.
2. Tunee can automatically search online for relevant information without needing all prompts from you.
3. Tunee can create music based on your uploaded game's video clips/images and capture the mood shift.
4. Tunee can export stems for further music fine-tuning.
5. (More to discover as you explore!)

Really appreciate all feedback and thank you so much for your time!

comments.author: KalmerHawkins
comments.body: Interesting, I may check it out this weekend. I made a 10 track soundtrack for my game with AI and yes, it was difficult to have them all sound consistent, so definitely see the value here. Are you open to saying how you're delivering the music on the back end, is it through a Suno or Elevenlabs or someone like that?

replies.author: trekkerxxx
replies.body: Sure!  used a mix of different models. One is called Tempolor and it's been great creating instrumental songs and they source data ethically. Please let me know your experience and feedback on the product.Thank you so much!!

comments.author: Mistah_Swick
comments.body: im building a 3D maze game right now i would love to try out adding music to the menus and gameplay if you dont mind!

replies.author: trekkerxxx
replies.body: Sure thing! You can hop on the discord and I will send you the code to try it out!

comments.author: DreamNotDeferred
comments.body: Nice work. I'd like to try it out if you still need testers.

replies.author: trekkerxxx
replies.body: Please! We need more! Love to hear your thoughts on this!!

replies.author: trekkerxxx
replies.body: Would love to have you test it and hear your feedback!!!
